project_name: Sound Lab - CODES Archive Design Extension
design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC & NEON (Black / Infrared High-Tech Tactical Archive)
instructions_to_main_agent: Extend the existing CODES Archive design system (#000000 / #0c0c0e background, #ff0a0a infrared active accents, #f0f0f5 off-white titles, #a0a0b0 monospace metadata) to both Home SoundLab carousel/cards and the /sound dedicated screen.
Completely remove the word 'FREE' and any 'free access', 'free streaming', 'free' badges/tags/copy from all song rows, album views, cards, and now playing panels across Sound Lab.
Do NOT alter pricing, access rules, or add paywalls. Sound Lab playback remains available as before, but without 'FREE' labels.
Preserve the actual six AlbumData entries: 96 MIRRORS (14 tracks with latest white cover), CODES, IN MEMORY OF, PRESENCE, '13, LUCID DREAMS. Do not invent albums or recordings.
Maintain strict mobile responsiveness fitting 320px–430px viewports (Expo RN / Mobile Web App) with minimum 44px touch targets for play/stop/album select controls.

Unify Home SoundLab carousel and /sound dedicated page to use the shared compact track row & now-playing readout components while keeping original audio plumbing intact (AudioEngine.playMedia on Home, expo-av/sound player on /sound).

layout_and_hierarchy.album_selection: Horizontal scrollable pill grid or tab bar with 6 albums. Active album has #ff0a0a border and #200909 background with off-white text.
layout_and_hierarchy.track_row: Compact list item with min-height 52px, 44px+ touch area. Left: track index/mono tag. Center: track title + duration. Right: Play/Stop trigger with infrared state highlight when active.
layout_and_hierarchy.now_playing: Sticky or fixed bottom bar (min-height 60px) in deep black/red accent background (#100606) with subtle 1px top border (#ff0a0a55), real-time progress bar in #ff0a0a, track title, elapsed time, and a 44px infrared STOP button.

component_structure.sound_lab_home: Nested carousel updated to display dark charcoal cards with fine #303036 borders, white 96 MIRRORS cover, and clean track list without 'FREE' tags.
component_structure.sound_lab_page: Dedicated /sound screen featuring Archive-styled header with Terminator title 'SOUND LAB ARCHIVE', 6-album selector, full 14-track listing for 96 MIRRORS, and bottom audio readout.
